name: close-control
description: Read-only close review tools over local files: view, queue and compare verified packs, and run close, BAS, payroll, statement, register and rule checks.
long_description: Runs the read-only commands of the close-control executable on files inside the folders you choose. It writes no file, reaches no network and approves nothing; every result is review evidence for a person.

tools.name: view
tools.description: Verify a saved close review pack's 4 files agree and display it.

tools.name: queue
tools.description: Verify several saved close packs and list them, optionally filtered or summarised.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare 2 verified close packs and their trial balances.

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Compare postings before and after a recode with supplied coding evidence.

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Review a canonical expense, migration, inter-entity, prepayment or roll-forward schedule.

tools.name: jet
tools.description: Journal-entry tests and a Benford first-digit test over one tenant's general-ledger listing.

tools.name: duplicates
tools.description: Check a document register for possible duplicate invoices or payments in a period.

tools.name: fixed-assets
tools.description: Tie a fixed-asset register to a trial balance by asset and accumulated depreciation accounts.

tools.name: coding
tools.description: Compare a period's account and tax coding against prior postings by the same supplier.

tools.name: scorecard
tools.description: Summarise saved check result JSON files for one tenant into a close scorecard.

tools.name: payroll
tools.description: Reperform PAYG withholding and super guarantee on a payroll register.

tools.name: statement
tools.description: Check that a bank statement's running balances and page totals tie out.

tools.name: bas
tools.description: Draft a BAS workpaper from a ledger, tax-code map and optional payroll register.

tools.name: prepost
tools.description: Review draft postings against prior posted transactions before posting.

tools.name: overdue
tools.description: Flag open invoices that are overdue relative to each customer's payment history.

tools.name: rules
tools.description: List every close review control, when it runs, what it checks and its source.

client_folder.title: Client folder
client_folder.description: Folder the tools may read. Every path a tool is given is relative to it.
